message: SABDHAM 1.2.7 is available with improved search matching and playback reliability.
releaseNotes: Improved closest-match search for mistyped song searches without changing the text you typed.
Improved search-result and playlist playback resolution.
Improved catalogue playback reliability while preserving the newer verified playback fallbacks.
Improved playlist title matching and playable-audio resolution.
SABDHAM artwork continues to use catalogue metadata instead of YouTube cover art.
